content.value_statement: UnoCSS projects often fail when generated utilities ignore the active presets and configuration. This skill grounds recommendations in project settings and focused UnoCSS references.
actual_capabilities: Reviews existing UnoCSS configuration conventions before recommending utilities.
Explains rules, shortcuts, themes, variants, extraction, safelists, layers, and preflights.
Guides Wind, Mini, Icons, Attributify, Typography, Web Fonts, Tagify, and Rem-to-Px presets.
Configures variant group, directives, compile class, and Attributify JSX transformers.
Shows Vite setup and UnoCSS modes for common frontend frameworks.
Shows Nuxt module setup, layer configuration merging, and inspector usage.
limitations: The references target UnoCSS 66.x and were generated on January 28, 2026.
The skill provides guidance and examples, but it does not execute builds or verify generated CSS.
Advanced syntax depends on installed presets, transformers, and the active project configuration.
Framework coverage focuses on Vite and Nuxt integrations.

use_cases.title: Set Up a Frontend Project
use_cases.description: Create a project-aware UnoCSS setup with suitable presets, imports, and content extraction.
use_cases.target_user: Frontend developer starting a Vite application

use_cases.title: Build Reusable Design Utilities
use_cases.description: Define theme tokens, dynamic rules, shortcuts, variants, and responsive behavior for a shared interface system.

use_cases.title: Integrate UnoCSS With Nuxt
use_cases.description: Configure the Nuxt module, merge layer settings, add presets, and locate the development inspector.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a New Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this project and configure UnoCSS with the simplest suitable preset. Preserve existing conventions and explain each changed file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for an existing frontend project

prompt_templates.title: Create Theme Utilities
prompt_templates.prompt: Create UnoCSS theme tokens and reusable shortcuts for this interface. Use the existing configuration and avoid unsupported utilities.

prompt_templates.title: Add Icons and Typography
prompt_templates.prompt: Add UnoCSS Icons and Typography presets to this Vite application. Include accessible usage examples and required imports.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Advanced Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design dynamic rules, variants, extraction sources, and layer ordering for these requirements. Assess conflicts with current presets and transformers.

output_examples.input: Help me add UnoCSS to this Vite project.
output_examples.output: A setup plan identifies the existing framework, selects a compatible preset, lists required configuration changes, and confirms the stylesheet import location.

output_examples.input: Create reusable button styles from our theme colors.
output_examples.output: A shortcut strategy maps approved theme colors to button variants, includes focus and disabled states, and avoids utilities unavailable in the project.

output_examples.input: Why are my dynamic utility classes missing?
output_examples.output: The diagnosis checks extraction boundaries, explains why constructed class names are invisible at build time, and recommends static mappings or a focused safelist.

best_practices: Inspect the project configuration before selecting utilities, presets, or advanced syntax.
Prefer static class names or explicit safelists so build-time extraction can discover every utility.
Keep theme units consistent and verify preset-specific token names before extending defaults.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Tailwind compatibility covers every preset, transformer, or theme key.
Do not construct class names dynamically when UnoCSS must extract them at build time.
Do not enable Attributify or experimental modes without confirming project support.

faq.question: Which UnoCSS version does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It targets UnoCSS 66.x using references generated on January 28, 2026.

faq.question: Does it support Tailwind CSS syntax?
faq.answer: Basic utility syntax is broadly familiar, but exact behavior depends on the selected UnoCSS preset.

faq.question: Can it configure Vite and Nuxt projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers the Vite plugin, common framework setups, the Nuxt module, and Nuxt layer configuration.

faq.question: Can it create custom rules and shortcuts?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains static and dynamic rules, theme-aware shortcuts, variants, layers, and preflights.

faq.question: Why should the existing configuration be inspected first?
faq.answer: The configuration determines available presets, rules, shortcuts, transformers, theme values, and supported syntax.

faq.question: Does the skill run UnoCSS or install packages?
faq.answer: No. It provides project guidance and examples; execution and package installation remain part of the user's development workflow.
